title: Batched Reversal Seq2Seq Debugging
prompt:
Complete a small batched sequence-to-sequence utility set. `shift_targets(targets, bos_id)` prepends BOS and removes the final target token. `masked_cross_entropy(logits, targets, pad_id)` averages cross entropy over non-PAD targets only. `greedy_decode(model, source, bos_id, eos_id, max_steps)` must run batched decoding without tracking gradients, append per-row greedy tokens, and stop once every row has emitted EOS; pass `eos_id=None` to disable early stopping.

`ReverseModel(vocab_size, embed_dim)` is a trainable module whose forward path takes a source batch and decoder input batch and returns logits of shape `(batch, decoder_length, vocab_size)`. Use batch-first tensors throughout.

example.reasoning: Teacher forcing predicts each target from its preceding decoder token.
